4037220.name: Chabad of Singer Island - Riviera Beach
4037220.note: Lubavitch.com, 'Seven in the Sunshine State: New Chabad Families in Florida' (2 Nov 2018): Rabbi Berel and Tzivia Namdar, Chabad of Singer Island. IRS: 'Chabad Of Singer Island & The Beaches Inc', exempt from Aug 2019.

4035363.name: Chabad of Downtown SRQ
4035363.note: Lubavitch.com (2 Nov 2018): Rabbi Levi and Leah Steinmetz, Chabad of Downtown Sarasota, among the seven new Chabad families in Florida. IRS: 'Chabad Of Downtown Srq Inc', exempt from Aug 2019.

4056808.name: Pensacola Chabad Jewish Center
4056808.note: Lubavitch.com (2 Nov 2018): Rabbi Mendel and Nechama Danow, Chabad of Pensacola, arrived just before Hurricane Michael ('two days behind us'; landfall 10 Oct 2018) and planned Pensacola's first grand menorah lighting that Chanukah.

6837101.name: Chabad Central Broward
6837101.note: Lubavitch.com (2 Nov 2018): Rabbi Shmuli and Nechama Heidingsfeld, Chabad of Lauderhill, among the seven new Chabad families in Florida. Today the same couple runs Chabad Central Broward in Lauderhill (IRS: 'Chabad Central Broward Inc', care of Shmuel Heidingsfeld, exempt from Aug 2022; the chabad.org listing is from 2025), so it is taken as the same work under a new name.

4067544.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Tamarac
4067544.note: Lubavitch.com (2 Nov 2018): Rabbi Kopel and Goldy Silberberg, Chabad Jewish Center of Tamarac, moved 'just before Rosh Hashanah' (5779: 10 Sept 2018). Tamarac Talk, 22 Aug 2023: it 'invites the community to celebrate five years since its founding'.

2292274.name: Center for Jewish Life at Chabad of St. Johns County
2292274.note: CrownHeights.info, 21 Aug 2013: Rabbi Mendel and Dini Sharfstein 'have been appointed by Rabbi Y. Kahanov ... as the directors of the latest Chabad Center on the First Coast to serve as a Center for Jewish Life for St. Johns, Nocatee, and World Golf Village', 'the first Jewish institution in the burgeoning St John's area'.

4114627.name: Chabad of Miami Gardens
4114627.note: CrownHeights.info, 20 March 2021 (Miami Gardens' first mikvah): 'Not even 3 years have passed since Rabbi Shalom and Mrs. Eliyah Kleinman moved to Miami Gardens and established a shul, kids programs, daily minyanim' (count back: 2018). IRS: 'Chabad Of Miami Gardens Inc', exempt from Dec 2020.

6451555.name: Chabad of North Beach
6451555.note: CrownHeights.info, 24 July 2025: 'We've just moved to North Beach/Biscayne Point to open a brand new Chabad House' (Rabbi Shneur and Bati Korf).

6976084.name: Chabad of Citrus and Hernando Counties
6976084.note: CrownHeights.info, 30 Oct 2025: 'Two months ago, Rabbi Moishy and Maryasha Serebryanski moved to Beverly Hills, Florida, to establish Chabad of Citrus and Hernando Counties' (month counted back).

6674554.name: Chabad of Winter Garden
6674554.note: CrownHeights.info, 3 Sept 2025: Rabbi Mendy Konikov 'moved to Winter Garden a month ago with his wife Sheina and their son to establish the new center' (after two years of visits for Chanukah, Purim and Pesach).

6640772.name: Chabad of Coastal Palm Beach
6640772.note: CrownHeights.info, 28 Aug 2025: 'In late 2024, Rabbi Mendy and Rivka Rotenstreich moved to Lake Worth Beach, Florida to establish a new Chabad presence there'.

6153769.name: Chabad of Key Largo
6153769.note: CrownHeights.info, 6 Feb 2024: 'Rabbi Yisrolik and Leah Shur together with their daughter Esther have recently opened the first Chabad center in Key Largo, Florida'; COLlive the same day: appointed 'to establish a full time Chabad Center in the Upper Keys'.

6339625.name: Chabad of Southwest Miami
6339625.note: COLlive, 26 June 2024: 'Rabbi Ari and Devorah Werbler have relocated from their home and community ... in Chicago, to build a Jewish community center in Southwest Miami.'

7025189.name: Chabad Israeli Center of Fort Myers
7025189.note: COLlive, 30 June 2025: 'In a moving celebration held on Sunday, June 29, 2025 ... Chabad Lubavitch of Southwest Florida ... officially welcomed new Shluchim to serve the growing Israeli population', Rabbi Shalom and Devorie Katz, 'who have arrived from Israel'.

7025214.name: Chabad of Margate
7025214.note: Margate Talk: Rabbi Mendel and Chaya Denburg moved from Brooklyn to set up the Chabad Jewish Community Center of Margate, launching with High Holiday services on Sept. 22-24 and Oct. 1-2 (Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur 5786, 2025); 'about 20 years since the city had its own Chabad'.

4239647.name: Chabad of Panama City Beach
4239647.note: Southern Jewish Life (29 Dec 2021): 'At the start of 2019, the Havlins arrived in Panama City Beach' (Rabbi Mendy and Chaya Havlin), invited by Achdut Israel, a small Sephardic congregation; an earlier SJL item announced the new Chabad. The page itself would not open (its certificate is broken); the quote is from search results. IRS: 'Chabad Of Panama City Beach Inc', exempt from March 2020.

6429432.name: Chabad of Amelia Island & Nassau County
6429432.note: Chabad.org, 18 Sept 2025: a resident 'got involved a year ago after seeing information about the brand new Chabad of Amelia Island and Nassau County on Facebook, just after the arrival of a charismatic young rabbi and his family' (Rabbi Levi and Mindy Katz; count back: 2024); the storefront center had its ribbon-cutting in August 2025.
